metaDescription: Order custom easy care apparel for your team. Wrinkle-resistant, low-maintenance shirts and vests perfect for uniforms and giveaways.
introHtml: Easy care apparel is engineered to resist wrinkles and hold its shape through repeated washings, making it a practical choice for uniforms, event staff, and corporate giveaways. Unlike standard cotton garments that require ironing, easy care fabrics like the polyester-cotton blends used in our Preston Long Sleeve Shirts and Core 365™ Journey Fleece Vests stay crisp with minimal effort. This means your logo stays looking sharp all day, whether your team is working a trade show booth or out in the field. Choose easy care apparel for a polished, professional appearance without the upkeep.
heroAltText: Custom easy care apparel including wrinkle-resistant dress shirts and fleece vests with embroidered logos
